name: DSDP_Project1 (ONS/LIDA International Passenger Survey replacement)
what_it_holds: Leeds Institute for Data Analytics (LIDA) x ONS Data Scientist Development Programme project to replace the UK International Passenger Survey (IPS) with non-survey sources (Mastercard transaction data, mobile/accommodation data mentioned) using ML. process.ipynb documents methodology exploring IPS microdata (trip purpose, expenditure, nationality) and candidate replacement signals. MIT license. No confirmed committed IPS microdata in-repo (references UK Data Service study 9279 as source).
why_useful: IPS covers exactly the trip-purpose/party-composition/length-of-stay microdata this theme targets, and this repo documents both the IPS variable structure and non-survey proxies (card spend) that could stand in for a discontinued/lagged survey -- relevant to gap on inbound trip-purpose mix and nowcasting substitutes.
size_hint: small (notebook + docs, no bulk data confirmed)
themes: Length-of-stay, party-size and trip-purpose survey microdata (NTTO SIAT, UK IPS, Eurostat tour_dem, Japan travel survey, national travel surveys)
why_all: IPS covers exactly the trip-purpose/party-composition/length-of-stay microdata this theme targets, and this repo documents both the IPS variable structure and non-survey proxies (card spend) that could stand in for a discontinued/lagged survey -- relevant to gap on inbound trip-purpose mix and nowcasting substitutes.

A methods + partial-data repo on exactly the theme (IPS discontinuation / replacement), potentially pointing to what administrative proxies (border crossings, mobile/roaming data, etc.) can stand in for the survey when the sanctioned IPS itself lags or is retired -- relevant to gap #20 and to point-in-time concerns (gap #4) since IPS has real publication lag.

name: Eurostat-Tourism-Data-Analysis
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed analysis project pulling and analyzing Eurostat tourism statistics (domain likely includes tour_occ / tour_dem series covering nights spent, trip purpose, duration bands by country). No confirmed row counts; a code-based acquisition/analysis pipeline against the Eurostat API rather than a static committed dataset.
why_useful: Eurostat's tour_dem dataset (EU demand-side tourism trips survey: purpose, duration, party/travel-group where available) is exactly the target series for this theme; this repo is a working example of pulling it programmatically, saving a fresh Eurostat API integration.
time_coverage: current Eurostat tour_dem vintages (survey runs ~2012-present, annual)
themes: Length-of-stay, party-size and trip-purpose survey microdata (NTTO SIAT, UK IPS, Eurostat tour_dem, Japan travel survey, national travel surveys)

name: vegas-tourism-insights
what_it_holds: Streamlit analytics app with a committed 'LVCVA Data.xlsx' (cleaned) in data/, sourced from official Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority releases. Fields per README: visitor volume, room nights occupied, occupancy rate, ADR, RevPAR, auto traffic on major highways, room tax collections. Includes a Jupyter notebook for cleaning/EDA and manual forecasts extending to June 2025. Exact year range not stated in README but framed as 'historical tourism trends' (multi-year monthly).
why_useful: Las Vegas is a top-10 US Airbnb/STR market and LVCVA publishes some of the best public monthly visitor-volume + ADR + RevPAR + hotel occupancy data among US destinations; a pre-cleaned, committed spreadsheet mirror saves re-scraping LVCVA's site and gives a monthly hotel-market comparator for Airbnb NA nights/ADR (addresses gap #8, hotel supply/demand benchmarking, and gap #2 realised ADR/occupancy analogue).
time_coverage: multi-year monthly (exact start/end not confirmed from README)
themes: Airport and city tourism dashboards scraped to CSV (NYC Tourism, Visit Florida, Las Vegas LVCVA, Orlando, Hawaii DBEDT, Destination DC, Visit California)
why_all: Las Vegas is a top-10 US Airbnb/STR market and LVCVA publishes some of the best public monthly visitor-volume + ADR + RevPAR + hotel occupancy data among US destinations; a pre-cleaned, committed spreadsheet mirror saves re-scraping LVCVA's site and gives a monthly hotel-market comparator for Airbnb NA nights/ADR (addresses gap #8, hotel supply/demand benchmarking, and gap #2 realised ADR/occupancy analogue).

name: hawaii-visitor-data-downloader
what_it_holds: Python script that downloads monthly visitor statistical report PDFs published by Hawaii DBEDT (Dept. of Business, Economic Development & Tourism). Supports a configurable year range (default 2018-2025), random User-Agent rotation, request delays, auto-retry, skips unavailable months (404), and resumes by skipping already-downloaded files. Output is a folder of DBEDT monthly PDFs, not parsed CSV.
why_useful: A robust, working one-command puller for Hawaii DBEDT's monthly visitor statistics PDFs going back to 2018 (we already use DBEDT for the party-size series; this tool would let us pull a fuller point-in-time monthly PDF archive rather than only the annual/monthly-highlights pages we currently have via Wayback) — useful for extending or refreshing gap #8 (Hawaii bed-tax/occupancy) and the party-size series baseline.
size_hint: script only; downloads PDFs, not a stored dataset
duplicate_of_holding: we already hold Hawaii DBEDT visitor stats per CONTEXT.md; this is a longer/more automatable PDF archive method, not identical data
themes: Airport and city tourism dashboards scraped to CSV (NYC Tourism, Visit Florida, Las Vegas LVCVA, Orlando, Hawaii DBEDT, Destination DC, Visit California)
why_all: A robust, working one-command puller for Hawaii DBEDT's monthly visitor statistics PDFs going back to 2018 (we already use DBEDT for the party-size series; this tool would let us pull a fuller point-in-time monthly PDF archive rather than only the annual/monthly-highlights pages we currently have via Wayback) — useful for extending or refreshing gap #8 (Hawaii bed-tax/occupancy) and the party-size series baseline.

name: dvw-data-portal
what_it_holds: Angular front-end for UHERO's 'DBEDT Visitor Warehouse' (DVW) data portal, serving Hawaii visitor-industry time series (visitor arrivals, spending, room demand/occupancy per public description at data.uhero.hawaii.edu/dvw/). Repo itself is just the Angular CLI app, no data files committed; the actual series live behind the paired dvw-api / data.uhero.hawaii.edu/dvw/ endpoint.
why_useful: UHERO's DBEDT Visitor Data Warehouse is a more granular, more frequently updated academic mirror of Hawaii tourism data than the DBEDT PDF reports we currently rely on — worth checking data.uhero.hawaii.edu/dvw/ directly for a queryable, possibly monthly/county-level, longer-history series (addresses gap #8 and possibly gap #2 for realised occupancy).
size_hint: frontend app only; data lives at external data.uhero.hawaii.edu/dvw/ endpoint
duplicate_of_holding: extends the Hawaii DBEDT visitor stats we already hold with a live, queryable warehouse
themes: Airport and city tourism dashboards scraped to CSV (NYC Tourism, Visit Florida, Las Vegas LVCVA, Orlando, Hawaii DBEDT, Destination DC, Visit California)
